narrativeWatchDetails.israeliPosition: In its April 5, 2024 statement, the IDF acknowledged fatal misidentification and serious procedural failures. Its August 19, 2026 decision said the circumstances did not raise reasonable suspicion warranting a criminal investigation. WCK rejected that account on the same date; the military decision is not a court judgment resolving all disputed facts.
narrativeWatchDetails.securityContext: Investigation candidate: the seven deaths and IDF responsibility are acknowledged in the IDF’s April 5, 2024 statement. The broader targeting-practice allegation remains a separate question. On August 19, 2026 the military prosecutor declined a criminal investigation; WCK disputed the account and renewed its demand for an independent inquiry. These are directly sourced opposing institutional positions, not an independent adjudication. No measured circulation trend is established.
